group_recording_rules.expr:
rate(oie_instance_mem_swap_in_bytes_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}[5m])
and oie_instance_mem_swap_in_bytes_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}

rate(oie_instance_cpu_steal_seconds_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}[5m])
and oie_instance_cpu_steal_seconds_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}

oie_host_libvirt_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_libvirt_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 0)
and on (job, instance) (time() - oie_host_libvirt_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} >= 0)
and on (job, instance) (time() - oie_host_libvirt_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} <= clamp_min(3 * oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}, 120))

oie_host_conntrack_raw_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_conntrack_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 0)
and on (job, instance) (time() - oie_host_conntrack_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} >= 0)
and on (job, instance) (time() - oie_host_conntrack_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} <= clamp_min(3 * oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}, 120))

oie_instance_state_code{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

oie:instance_running
and on (job, instance) oie:conntrack_ready

oie_instance_resource_axis_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
and (oie_instance_resource_axis_available{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:instance_running

avg_over_time(oie:activity:sample[5m])
and oie:activity:sample
and (count_over_time(oie:activity:sample[5m]) >= 3)

avg_over_time(oie:activity:sample[2m])
and oie:activity:sample
and (count_over_time(oie:activity:sample[2m]) >= 2)

quantile_over_time(0.95, oie:activity:sample[1d:5m] offset 1h)
and (count_over_time(oie:activity:sample[1d:5m] offset 1h) >= 72)
oie:activity:recent / clamp_min(oie:activity:baseline, 1)
oie:activity:recent - oie:activity:baseline
oie:activity:fast / clamp_min(oie:activity:baseline, 1)
oie:activity:recent{signal="cpu_percent"}

stddev_over_time(oie:activity:sample[1d:5m] offset 1h)
and oie:activity:baseline

oie:activity:recent > 3 * oie:activity:baseline
and (oie:activity:recent - oie:activity:baseline > 3 * oie:activity:deviation)

max by (job, instance, domain, server_name, instance_uuid, project_uuid, project_name, user_uuid)(
  (oie_instance_mining_suspected{confidence="high",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
  or (
    oie_instance_mining_suspected{confidence="shared",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
    and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) (oie:cpu_percent_5m >= 35)
  )
  or (
    oie_instance_mining_suspected{confidence="shared_persistent",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1
    and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) (oie:cpu_percent_5m >= 60)
  )
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network_current

oie_host_cpu_usage_percent{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 95
and on (job, instance) (sum by (job, instance)(oie:cpu:steal_ratio and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:resource_axis_current{axis="cpu"}) / sum by (job, instance)(oie_instance_cpu_vcpu_count{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:resource_axis_current{axis="cpu"}) > 0.05)
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

oie_host_mem_available_mib{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} / oie_host_mem_mib_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} < 0.02
and on (job, instance) (sum by (job, instance)(oie:memory:swap_in_bytes_per_second and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:resource_axis_current{axis="mem"}) > 1048576)
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

(oie:disk:read_latency_seconds > 0.15)
or (oie:disk:write_latency_seconds > 0.1)
or (oie:disk:flush_latency_seconds > 0.04)

(oie:network:rx_drop_ratio > 0.02)
or (oie:network:tx_drop_ratio > 0.02)
or (oie:network:rx_error_ratio > 0.02)
or (oie:network:tx_error_ratio > 0.02)

(
  oie:network_current
  and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:packet_impact
)
or (
  oie:network_current
  and on (job, instance) (oie_host_conntrack_utilization{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} >= 0.8)
)

annotations.description: CPU {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}% with vCPU scheduler waiting >5%. CPU is unusual and >=20%, or >=95%. Check host contention and expected workload. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
(
  (oie:activity:unusual{signal="cpu_percent"} >= 20)
  or (oie:activity:recent{signal="cpu_percent"} >= 95)
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) (oie:cpu:steal_ratio > 0.05)

annotations.description: vCPU {{ $labels.vcpu }} scheduler waiting {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}; limit 5% over five minutes. Check host CPU and VM placement. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie:cpu:steal_ratio > 0.05
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:resource_axis_current{axis="cpu"}

annotations.description: Guest swap-in {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} B/s; limit 64 MiB/s over five minutes. Check guest memory pressure. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie:memory:swap_in_bytes_per_second > 67108864
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:resource_axis_current{axis="mem"}

annotations.description: Major faults {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}/s with guest swap-in >1 MiB/s. Check guest paging and memory pressure. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
(
  oie:activity:recent{signal="major_faults_per_second"} >= 200
  and (
    (
      oie:activity:recent{signal="major_faults_per_second"} > oie:activity:baseline{signal="major_faults_per_second"} * 3
      and (oie:activity:increase{signal="major_faults_per_second"} >= 200)
    )
    or (oie:activity:recent{signal="major_faults_per_second"} >= 2000)
  )
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) (oie:memory:swap_in_bytes_per_second > 1048576)

oie_instance_threat_tor_exit_active_flows{direction=~"out|any",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 0
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="TOREXIT"} == 1)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:pressure

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} active flow matches against Tor relay. Packet problems or host conntrack pressure also qualify. Check destination and authorized workload; a list match does not prove compromise. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_instance_threat_tor_relay_active_flows{direction=~"out|any",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 0
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="TORRELAY"} == 1)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:pressure

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} active flow matches against Spamhaus. Undirected matches also require network pressure. Check destination and authorized workload; a list match does not prove compromise. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
(
  oie_instance_threat_spamhaus_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="out"} > 0
  or (
    oie_instance_threat_spamhaus_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="any"} > 0
    and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:pressure
  )
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network_current
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="spamhaus"} == 1)

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} active flow matches against Emerging Threats. Undirected matches also require network pressure. Check destination and authorized workload; a list match does not prove compromise. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
(
  oie_instance_threat_emergingthreats_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="out"} > 0
  or (
    oie_instance_threat_emergingthreats_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="any"} > 0
    and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:pressure
  )
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network_current
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="EMERGING"} == 1)

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} active flow matches against custom list. Undirected matches also require network pressure. Check destination and authorized workload; a list match does not prove compromise. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
(
  oie_instance_threat_customlist_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="out"} > 0
  or (
    oie_instance_threat_customlist_active_flows{job="openstack-instance-exporter",direction="any"} > 0
    and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network:pressure
  )
)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network_current
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="CUSTOMLIST"} == 1)

annotations.description: Qualified mining-like evidence (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}); shared-port evidence also meets its CPU requirement. Check endpoint evidence and authorized workload; this does not confirm mining. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr: oie:mining_warning == 1

annotations.description: Persistent dedicated-port mining candidate (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}) with CPU >=40%. Check endpoint evidence and authorized workload; this does not confirm mining. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.
annotations.summary: Persistent mining candidate with CPU corroboration — {{ $labels.server_name }}

group_rules.expr:
max by (job, instance, domain, server_name, instance_uuid, project_uuid, project_name, user_uuid)(oie_instance_mining_suspected{confidence="high_persistent",job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) (oie:cpu_percent_5m >= 40)
and on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:network_current
unless on (job, instance, instance_uuid) oie:mining_warning

annotations.description: Copy has waited >=10m for pivot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check Nova/Cinder logs and the block job; this is a compute-local observation. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}. Disk: {{ $labels.disk_path }}; volume: {{ $labels.volume_uuid }}. Destination: {{ $labels.destination_volume_uuid }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_instance_disk_retype_status_code{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 6
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

annotations.description: Block-job observation failed (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}) while Libvirt is healthy. Check block-job RPC logs; missing observations do not prove a stall or completion. VM: {{ $labels.instance_uuid }}. Project: {{ $labels.project_name }} ({{ $labels.project_uuid }}). Host: {{ $labels.instance }}. Disk: {{ $labels.disk_path }}; volume: {{ $labels.volume_uuid }}. Destination: {{ $labels.destination_volume_uuid }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_instance_disk_retype_observation_healthy{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 0
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

annotations.description: Exporter scrape failed (up={{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check exporter service and scrape connectivity. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr: up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 0

annotations.description: Exporter CPU {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} cores exceeds 0.5 and collection uses >=80% of its interval. Check collection durations and instance/flow counts. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}[5m]) > 0.5
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_collection_cycle_duration_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} / oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} >= 0.8)

annotations.description: Provider IP {{ $labels.ip }} matches {{ $labels.list }} (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check IP ownership and the list entry. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_provider_ip_listed{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list=~"spamhaus|EMERGING|CUSTOMLIST"} > 0
and on (job, instance, list) (oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Host conntrack usage {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}; limit 80%. Check connection pools and top contributing instances. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_conntrack_utilization{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 0.8
and on (job, instance) oie:conntrack_ready

annotations.description: Collection uses {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of its interval; limit 80%. Check Libvirt and conntrack collection durations. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_collection_cycle_duration_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} / clamp_min(oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}, 1) >= 0.8
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Host CPU {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}%; limit 95%, excluding idle and I/O wait. Check workload placement and guest scheduler delay. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_cpu_usage_percent{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > 95
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

annotations.description: Available host memory {{ $value | humanizePercentage }}; minimum 5%. Check resident memory, allocations and guest paging. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_mem_available_mib{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} / oie_host_mem_mib_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} < 0.05
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

annotations.description: {{ printf "%.3g" $value }} conntrack read errors in ten minutes; limit 5. Check timeout, ENOBUFS and parse-error logs. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
increase(oie_host_conntrack_read_errors_total{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}[10m]) > 5
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Conntrack reader failed (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}) while Libvirt is healthy. Check conntrack collection logs. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_conntrack_raw_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 0
and on (job, instance) oie:libvirt_ready

annotations.description: Last successful conntrack read was {{ $value | humanizeDuration }} ago; limit is max(2m, three collection intervals). Check stalled collection. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
time() - oie_host_conntrack_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > clamp_min(3 * oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}, 120)
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_conntrack_raw_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Last successful Libvirt read was {{ $value | humanizeDuration }} ago; limit is max(4m, three collection intervals). Check stalled collection. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
time() - oie_host_libvirt_last_success_timestamp_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} > clamp_min(3 * oie_host_collection_interval_seconds{job="openstack-instance-exporter"}, 240)
and on (job, instance) (oie_host_libvirt_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Libvirt collection failed (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}); retained resource values are not current. Check Libvirt connectivity and collection logs. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_libvirt_ok{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Host CPU {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}% exceeds 95% (excluding idle and I/O wait), with aggregate guest scheduler waiting >5% of allocated vCPU time. Check affected guests and workload placement. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr: oie:host_cpu_impact

annotations.description: Available host memory {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} is below 2%, with aggregate guest swap-in >1 MiB/s. Check host headroom and guest paging. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.
annotations.summary: Very low host memory with guest paging — {{ $labels.instance }}

group_rules.expr: oie:host_memory_impact

annotations.description: Enabled Tor exit feed has no usable snapshot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check feed refresh/download logs; a failed refresh with a usable snapshot does not qualify. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="TOREXIT"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Enabled Tor relay feed has no usable snapshot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check feed refresh/download logs; a failed refresh with a usable snapshot does not qualify. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="TORRELAY"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Enabled Spamhaus feed has no usable snapshot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check feed refresh/download logs; a failed refresh with a usable snapshot does not qualify. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="spamhaus"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Enabled Emerging Threats feed has no usable snapshot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check feed refresh/download logs; a failed refresh with a usable snapshot does not qualify. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="EMERGING"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)

annotations.description: Enabled custom list feed has no usable snapshot (state {{ printf "%.3g" $value }}). Check feed refresh/download logs; a failed refresh with a usable snapshot does not qualify. Host: {{ $labels.instance }}.

group_rules.expr:
oie_host_threat_feed_fresh{job="openstack-instance-exporter",list="CUSTOMLIST"} == 0
and on (job, instance) (up{job="openstack-instance-exporter"} == 1)
